posts.title: A package manager for unpackaged software
posts.description: A lot of software is available from github or similar sources, but not (yet) from my systems’ repositories, or only in a version that is too old for what I need. Installing from those sources is tedious and also requires active checking for updates and such. Also, removing such software may also be a little more involved than necessary.

posts.title: Welcome to tset.de!
posts.description: Welcome to the rebuild of tset.de. I’ve switched to a static site builder. The content is basically the same as before, with some things still in the pipeline.

posts.title: Command shortcuts for linux
posts.description: Shell aliases are nice, but very shell specific. On my personal computers, I use the fish shell, but for work I use bash, so this is not really portable. As the need arose to simplify some of my command line one-liners, I opted for door two, which is a small program that implements command shortcuts.
